about_the_game:
You are the Void Priest. Bound to an Elder God against your will.

A Lovecraftian psychological horror detective - told through rituals, relics, and madness.

Your task is to prepare the world for its arrival.

Your choice is whether to obey… or betray.

A World Without Screens

No HUD. No menus. No breaks in immersion.

Every signal lives inside the world itself:

  • A candle’s bloom is your health and sanity.

  • Symbols in the book shift as you begin to understand.

  • Relics are both tools and truths.

The Detective of the Unknowable

You are not only a servant. You are an investigator.

To survive, you must read the world and people like a puzzle and uncover what others cannot.

  • Connect fragments of evidence on your board.

  • Reveal what hides behind reality.

  • Decipher the forbidden language to open doors no one should.

Survival Is Not Combat

You do not fight monsters - you endure them.

Survival means completing the rite before your mind collapses.

Your relics define your path.

Knowledge Is Progress, Mystery Is the Test

There are no numbers, no bars. Only what you understand - and what it costs you. What you discover is what you become.

Every solved mystery sharpens perception, clears visions, and bends the world to your will - but each revelation costs you a piece of sanity.

Endings Carved in Madness

Your decisions shape not just your fate, but reality itself. Each playthrough reshapes fate with new outcomes.

  • Ascension

  • Martyrdom

  • Corrupted Immortality

  • And many more

Features

  • Lovecraftian psychological horror detective experience.

  • No HUD, no menus - the world itself is your interface.

  • Minimal text/voices with symbolic language and world-driven feedback.

  • Intuitive, context-aware controls and immediate immersion (no menu transitions).

  • Lo-fi visuals with strong atmosphere - runs even on weak PCs.

  • Survival through knowledge and rituals, not combat.

  • Replayable outcomes shaped by mysteries solved, choices made, and sanity endured.

content_descriptors.notes:
Psychological horror and disturbing imagery.
Depictions of occult rituals, cult activity, and human sacrifice.
Stylized blood and violence, but not gore-focused.
Themes of madness, loss of control, and manipulation by higher powers.
References to self-harm, death, and religious/cosmic despair.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 64-bit (or equivalent)
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU (Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.2 compatible GPU (NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 460 / Intel Arc A310 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
